mapper.select: SELECT d.cl_code AS "clCode", g.cl_code_nm AS "clCodeNm", d.code AS "code", d.code_nm AS "codeNm", d.sort_ordr AS "sortOrdr", d.use_yn AS "useYn" FROM comtccmmncodedetail d JOIN comtccmmnclcode g ON g.cl_code=d.cl_code ORDER BY d.cl_code, d.sort_ordr
SELECT cl_code AS "clCode", cl_code_nm AS "clCodeNm" FROM comtccmmnclcode ORDER BY cl_code

SELECT d.cl_code AS "clCode", g.cl_code_nm AS "clCodeNm", d.code AS "code", d.code_nm AS "codeNm", d.sort_ordr AS "sortOrdr", d.use_yn AS "useYn" FROM comtccmmncodedetail d JOIN comtccmmnclcode g ON g.cl_code=d.cl_code WHERE d.cl_code=#{clCode} AND d.code=#{code}
SELECT count(*) FROM comtccmmnclcode WHERE cl_code=#{clCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comtccmmnclcode(cl_code, cl_code_nm) VALUES(#{clCode}, #{clCodeNm}) ON CONFLICT (cl_code) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO comtccmmncodedetail(cl_code, code, code_nm, sort_ordr, use_yn) VALUES(#{clCode}, #{code}, #{codeNm}, COALESCE(#{sortOrdr},0), COALESCE(#{useYn},'Y'))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM comtccmmncodedetail WHERE cl_code=#{clCode} AND code=#{code}
mapper.select: SELECT e.emplyr_id AS "emplyrId", e.user_nm AS "userNm", e.email_adres AS "emailAdres", e.ofcps_nm AS "ofcpsNm", e.dept_code AS "deptCode", e.emplyr_sttus AS "emplyrSttus", e.lock_at AS "lockAt", to_char(e.last_login_dt,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "lastLoginDt", (SELECT string_agg(author_code, ',') FROM comtnempauthor a WHERE a.emplyr_id=e.emplyr_id) AS "roles" FROM comtnemplyrinfo e ORDER BY e.emplyr_id

SELECT emplyr_id AS "emplyrId", user_nm AS "userNm", email_adres AS "emailAdres", ofcps_nm AS "ofcpsNm", dept_code AS "deptCode", emplyr_sttus AS "emplyrSttus", lock_at AS "lockAt" FROM comtnemplyrinfo WHERE emplyr_id=#{emplyrId}
SELECT count(*) FROM comtnemplyrinfo WHERE emplyr_id=#{emplyrId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comtnemplyrinfo(emplyr_id, user_nm, password, email_adres, ofcps_nm, dept_code, emplyr_sttus, lock_at, pwd_chg_dt) VALUES(#{emplyrId}, #{userNm}, #{password}, #{emailAdres}, #{ofcpsNm}, #{deptCode}, COALESCE(#{emplyrSttus},'P'), COALESCE(#{lockAt},'N'), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE comtnemplyrinfo SET user_nm=#{userNm}, email_adres=#{emailAdres}, ofcps_nm=#{ofcpsNm}, dept_code=#{deptCode}, emplyr_sttus=COALESCE(#{emplyrSttus},'P'), lock_at=COALESCE(#{lockAt},'N') WHERE emplyr_id=#{emplyrId}
UPDATE comtnemplyrinfo SET password=#{password}, pwd_chg_dt=now(), fail_cnt=0 WHERE emplyr_id=#{emplyrId}
mapper.select: SELECT author_code AS "authorCode", author_nm AS "authorNm" FROM comtnauthorinfo ORDER BY author_code
SELECT author_code FROM comtnempauthor WHERE emplyr_id=#{emplyrId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comtnempauthor(emplyr_id, author_code) VALUES(#{emplyrId}, #{authorCode}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT author_code AS "authorCode", author_nm AS "authorNm", author_de AS "authorDe" FROM comtnauthorinfo WHERE author_code=#{authorCode}
SELECT count(*) FROM comtnauthorinfo WHERE author_code=#{authorCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comtnauthorinfo(author_code, author_nm, author_de) VALUES(#{authorCode}, #{authorNm}, #{authorDe})
mapper.update: UPDATE comtnauthorinfo SET author_nm=#{authorNm}, author_de=#{authorDe} WHERE author_code=#{authorCode}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM comtnempauthor WHERE author_code=#{authorCode}

SELECT m.menu_no AS "menuNo", m.menu_nm AS "menuNm", m.menu_url AS "menuUrl", m.upper_menu_no AS "upperMenuNo", m.menu_ordr AS "menuOrdr", m.use_yn AS "useYn", p.menu_nm AS "upperMenuNm" FROM comtnmenuinfo m LEFT JOIN comtnmenuinfo p ON p.menu_no=m.upper_menu_no ORDER BY COALESCE(m.upper_menu_no, m.menu_no), m.menu_ordr, m.menu_no
SELECT count(*) FROM comtnmenuinfo WHERE menu_no=#{menuNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comtnmenuinfo(menu_no, menu_nm, menu_url, upper_menu_no, menu_ordr, use_yn) VALUES(#{menuNo}, #{menuNm}, #{menuUrl}, #{upperMenuNo}, COALESCE(#{menuOrdr},0), COALESCE(#{useYn},'Y'))
mapper.update: UPDATE comtnmenuinfo SET menu_nm=#{menuNm}, menu_url=#{menuUrl}, upper_menu_no=#{upperMenuNo}, menu_ordr=COALESCE(#{menuOrdr},0), use_yn=COALESCE(#{useYn},'Y') WHERE menu_no=#{menuNo}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM comtnmenuinfo WHERE upper_menu_no=#{menuNo}
SELECT menu_no FROM comtnauthormenu WHERE author_code=#{authorCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comtnauthormenu(author_code, menu_no) VALUES(#{authorCode}, #{menuNo}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_no AS "menuNo", m.menu_nm AS "menuNm", m.menu_url AS "menuUrl", m.menu_ordr AS "menuOrdr" FROM comtnmenuinfo m JOIN comtnauthormenu am ON am.menu_no = m.menu_no WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' AND m.menu_url IS NOT NULL AND am.author_code IN #{r} ORDER BY "menuOrdr", "menuNo"
